scientific_scope: Physical modern carbonized papyrus phantom with deliberately lead-containing ink; suitable for sampling and geometry controls. Not an ancient carbon-ink validation, unread-scroll discovery, optical-label benchmark, or prize claim.

dataset.title: Modern recreation of carbonized Herculaneum scroll with lead containing ink for X-ray imaging and reading experiments.
dataset.voxel_pitch_interpretation: Nominal isotropic 130 micrometre sampling used for this control; source wording is retained verbatim. No independent voxel-size calibration performed.
dataset.pixel_shape_status: Unknown before frozen acquisition; every decoded slice must be finite float32 and have one common shape.
dataset.annotation_status: No optical/manual ink masks are listed among the two released dataset components; none are acquired or claimed.

readme.canonical_resolution: Observed HTTP GET 302 Location without query parameters, then direct HTTP 200; no automatic redirects used in implementation preflight.
readme.storage: Raw README is retained only in private metadata cache; personal/contact fields are omitted from this manifest.

accounting.historical_request_count_caveat: The 259 new acquisition requests are exactly instrumented and redirect-free. The 300 charged-request cap includes 29 reported/instrumented prior direct calls and an explicit 12-hop allowance. Earlier redirect hops and web-source provider transport are unknown, so an exact all-session wire-request total cannot be certified.
accounting.body_byte_scope: Bytes read from HTTP response bodies by these direct source-acquisition scripts; HTTP headers/TLS overhead and the web-source licence retrieval are excluded. Original Frag3 metadata is included in the 94,210-byte historical charge. No source pixels were read during either preflight.
